title: Progress Support Studies
description: Five independent studies that extend the share-card language to weekly summaries, recovery insights, habit boards, and long-cycle training milestones.
creative_direction: Independent rollout studies for Workout Progress Share Card System. Each image explores a realistic progress-sharing surface for apps or communities while keeping the visuals clean, non-readable, and emotionally rewarding.
